title: Implement Tactus dependency metadata fixes and lockfile update
description: Adjust Tactus runtime dependency declarations to avoid unnecessary pydantic-ai provider extras churn in downstream resolution; update poetry lock; verify local install/test sanity.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Started work. Next: create feature branch from develop, adjust dependency metadata in pyproject.toml to reduce resolver backtracking for downstream consumers, refresh lockfile, and prepare for local test run by maintainer.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented Tactus dependency metadata stabilization on feature/tactus-dependency-metadata-stability: switched runtime dep from pydantic-ai==1.46.0 to pydantic-ai-slim==1.46.0 to avoid transitive provider extras, tightened dev fastmcp to >=3.1.0,<3.2.0, and regenerated poetry.lock successfully (poetry lock + poetry check passed). Ready for full test suite validation.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Follow-up from local test run: evaluator test suite fails due to missing pydantic_evals after switching to pydantic-ai-slim. Plan: add pydantic-evals back in Tactus dev extra (not runtime deps), regenerate lock, and revalidate install/test path.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented follow-up fix for evaluator failures: added pydantic-evals==1.46.0 to [project.optional-dependencies].dev, regenerated poetry.lock, and validated pyproject with poetry check. This keeps runtime on pydantic-ai-slim while restoring eval test dependencies in dev installs.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented and validated dependency metadata stabilization in Tactus. Commit: 2675abef. Changes: runtime pydantic-ai -> pydantic-ai-slim, dev fastmcp >=3.1.0,<3.2.0, restored pydantic-evals in dev extra, regenerated poetry.lock. Validation: poetry check and targeted eval tests (63 passed).
